analysis.title: GS Early Morning Research Recap: Ratings and Target Price Changes - November 16, 2026 as of 5:30 AM ET
key_insights: Goldman downgraded YETI to Neutral from Buy after its 3Q26 earnings review, citing softer near-term growth and margin visibility. The price target was cut to $41 from $57 against a last price of $39.42.
Goldman reinstated Somnigroup International (SGI) at Neutral from Not Rated. The note says company-specific initiatives are intact but the stock awaits a macro turn.

SCA (Sweden) was cut to Sell from Neutral on valuation after a recent rerating, with the note calling containerboard momentum unsustainable. The target moved to Skr102 from Skr121. Asian Paints (India) was upgraded to Neutral from Sell as competition headwinds and input costs recede.
Pipelines and MLPs: Goldman remains constructive on natural gas pipelines after recent volatility and focuses on Buy-rated WMB and TRP. DTM was upgraded to Neutral.
Expand Energy (EXE): Buy reiterated, with the target cut to $103 from $117 against a last price of $88.53, citing soft gas pricing and a management transition.

Largest target price cuts in the Americas table: INVZ to $0.20 from $0.40, YETI to $41 from $57, EXE to $103 from $117, Inter & Co. to $8.00 from $9.00 (Buy), GEMI to $3.75 from $4.25 (Sell) and Banco do Brasil to R$13.00 from R$19.50 (Sell, 14% downside).

Aerospace and defense coverage (Poponak): Buy on Aevex (beat and raise, backlog supports growth), HawkEye 360, CAE and Embraer. Sell on Mercury Systems and Bombardier. Neutral on Firefly, Rocket Lab, Virgin Galactic, York Space Systems and Archer. Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) was covered after Starship Flight 15 achieved the first Starship tower catch.

Tech earnings: Cisco F1Q27 was a beat and raise on networking and opex but orders missed. Applied Materials had a solid quarter with margin outperformance that sets up accelerating growth in 2027. CoreWeave received a model update and a note on CEO and CFO meetings pointing to increasingly visible cash flow.

Fintech and crypto-linked names: Gemini Space Station (GEMI) 3Q26 showed continued expense discipline but weaker operating results and outlook. Robinhood (HOOD) October net deposits were robust against softer volumes. Schwab October showed a decline in cash but healthy net new assets.

Healthcare: Summit Therapeutics (SMMT) received a complete response letter (CRL) for ivonescimab in 2L EGFR-mutant lung cancer. Moderna says it is ready to launch intismeran ahead of a regulatory filing by year-end 2026. Merck valuation sensitivities were assessed ahead of upcoming intismeran readouts.

Macro and strategy headline calls: GS's 2027 US outlook is titled 'The End of the Inflation Shocks', and a separate note asks how much energy-shock passthrough to consumer prices is left. The Japan outlook calls for faster rate hikes on resilient growth and resurgent inflation. The oil outlook is titled 'Adaptation'.

Asia and EM strategy: GS raised India, China H-shares and Mexico to Overweight and lowered Taiwan, Brazil and China A to Marketweight. It expects further EM gains and broadening in 2027 and expects TOPIX to deliver a double-digit gain in 2027.
Japan Aerospace & Defense: reports of a lower defense budget would pose downside risks to estimates if confirmed. GS keeps a preference for MHI.

China Internet: GS contextualizes evolving US policies on rented compute access for China's AI models, cloud service providers and data centers. Kanzhun (BZ) stays Buy with the target cut to $19 from $22.
Metals: GS cut its 2027 iron ore forecast to about US$90/t and flagged that CMRG value leakage could reach US$10bn.

Upcoming events: 2027 Oil Outlook webinar on Nov 18 at 9 AM ET, GS Monthly US Equity Flow and Positioning webinar on Nov 18 at 1 PM ET, Equities and Credit for 2027 on Nov 19 at 10:30 AM ET, and Nike Investor Day, for which GS published a preview.

earnings_insights: YETI 3Q26 earnings review (reported, per GS note title): downgrade to Neutral as near-term growth and margin visibility softens. No EPS figure is given in this recap.
Cisco F1Q27 (reported): GS calls it a beat and raise on networking and opex with an orders miss. No figures are given in this recap.
Applied Materials (reported quarter): solid quarter with margin outperformance that sets the stage for accelerating growth in 2027. No figures are given in this recap.
Aevex (reported): beat and raise, with backlog supporting continued strong growth.
Gemini Space Station 3Q26 EPS (reported): continued expense discipline but weaker operating results and outlook.
Innoviz Technologies: a delayed auto program leads to lower 2026 guidance.
Inter & Co. 3Q26 call (reported quarter): initial 2027 loan growth expectations of 20-25%. IRB(Re) 3Q26 call: total premiums could grow about 10% in 2027.
Upcoming and recent: Kanzhun and SHEIN have 3Q26 previews. KB Financial, Hansol Chemical (3Q26 below expectations) and Robotis (3Q26 miss on bonus payments) have reported.
